title: Casey, Illinois lightning detector (Ecowitt gateway)
instrument: Ecowitt gateway with lightning sensor (strike count and last-strike distance only; no energy or bearing)
location_note: Casey, Illinois ground station. Exact coordinates are not published for this stream.
notes: Strike times are logged when the gateway's last-strike time changes, so strikes between polls can be missed. Daily count resets at local midnight (America/Chicago).
